WITH bucket_counts AS (
    SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM riskandmargin AS r
    JOIN orders AS o
      ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
    GROUP BY o.timespan
), shares AS (
    SELECT record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM bucket_counts
), kept AS (
    SELECT share
    FROM shares
    WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(record_count) FROM bucket_counts WHERE record_count::numeric / (SELECT SUM(record_count) FROM bucket_counts) > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)), 0) AS total_count,
    AVG(share) AS average_share,
    AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) AS average_excess
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: The SQL dialect is PostgreSQL; NULL timespan values form one bucket, and numeric division is used to avoid integer truncation.
